notes: Mayor Watters extended congratulations to the Fergus Whalers Hockey Club on their extraordinary championship season, recognizing their exceptional skill, determination, and teamwork. items.title: Catherine Pan, Senior Development Manager of Sorbara Development
notes: Group - re: Agenda Item 11.3 - Heritage Designation Recommendation - 8076 Wellington Road 19, Fergus

Catherine Pan, Senior Development Manager of Sorbara Development provided an update on the 40-hectare parcel located at Garafraxa Street and First Line. The property includes a heritage house that is currently listed but not yet designated. It was noted that Official Plan Amendment (OPA) 26 brought these lands into the Fergus urban boundary.

She discussed the importance of preserving both the property and the heritage home, noting future development could include community, commercial, and residential uses, while taking into consideration the uniqueness and history of the home. She also mentioned landscaping, parking requirements, how the development will interface with the surrounding community and expressed support for staff’s recommendation to proceed with the designation of the home.
C. Pan responded to comments and questions from Council regarding the tenant and timing of the development.

items.title: Appointment of Environmental Protection Officer
notes: Report from Gerry Atkinson, Manager of Wastewater Services THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington execute a by-law to appoint Andrew Marshall as an Environmental Protection Officer for the Township.

Item 11.5 - Notice of Study Completion - Transit Feasibility Study Report from Colin Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services Councillor Wilton requested this item be separated for further discussion and inquired about implementation timelines for transit moving forward.

Colin Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services provided a brief update regarding the transit feasibility study and noted that the final plan is ready for review by various stakeholders. After a 30 to 45-day time period, the intention is to meet with the County with the potential to review shared grant and funding opportunities regarding a transit program.
Item 11.4 - Notice of Study Commencement for an Environmental Assessment Addendum - Fergus Golf Course Redevelopment
Councillor Wilton requested this item be separated for further discussion and inquired about the larger scale of area of the presented study in the report versus the originally planned study.

Colin Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services noted that the study has expanded due to the scope of the project potentially changing to a larger subdivision development. This project plan change has impacted the potential infrastructure plan at the Township level and requires additional impact studies to ensure that items like wastewater are being appropriately planned for prior to development.

C. Baker and B. Salmon responded to comments and questions from Council regarding the outflow of the wastewater treatment plant, potential change in number of housing units, urban boundary development practices and centralized/communal systems, and the impact on staffing and financial implications.

items.title: Technical Rescue Services Agreements with Neighbouring Municipalities
notes: Report from Jason Benn, Fire Chief
Jason Benn, Fire Chief provided a brief update regarding the proposed technical rescue service agreements with regard to fire and emergency response with neighbouring municipalities.

J. Benn noted that these technical rescue events are high-risk and low- occurrence and reported that the municipality is positioned to support local neighbouring municipalities with these technical responses. He noted that deployments only occur when local levels are maintained and available and is based on a full cost-recovery model.

items.title: Zoning Amendment RZ05-2026 Decision Report - 7010 Third Line, West
notes: Garafraxa
Report from Deanna Maiden, Senior Development Planner

Deanna Maiden, Senior Development Planner provided a summary of the report with respect to the property located at 7010 Third Line, the property is designated Prime Agricultural and contains lands identified as Greenlands and Core Greenlands, the amendment is to rezone the lands from Agricultural to Agricultural Exception to prohibit residential uses.

She noted the property was previously the subject of severance application, severance was conditionally approved in February 2026 by the County Land Division Committee, and the zoning amendment is being requested to satisfy a condition of the application.

items.title: Request for Tender #43-26 / Reconstruction of Smith Street and Victoria
notes: Crescent, Elora

Report from Adam McNabb, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer Adam McNabb, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer provided an overview of the report outlining the reconstruction of Smith Street and Victoria Crescent in Elora, a multi-phase project that will renew underground infrastructure and improve safety in the road corridor for all users.

He noted that, as part of the project, Smith Street will be upgraded from David Street West to Henderson Street. The Request for Tender (RFT) was issued in accordance with the Township’s Purchasing Requirements By-law and was limited to prequalified contractors. In keeping with the procurement process, the contract will be awarded to the lowest compliant bidder.

Colin Baker, Managing Director of Infrastructure Services responded to questions from council regarding the contractor prequalification process, noting that more than 30 contractors expressed interest in the project, with 22 ultimately meeting the qualification requirements and being placed on the prequalified list.

He advised that project signage will be installed and that staff will reconnect with the community following the contract award to provide updated project information. Construction is scheduled to begin during the current construction season, with the successful contractor responsible for providing the schedule and official start date.
C. Baker also responded to questions related to detour routes, noting that Smith Street will be restricted to local access only during construction.

Pedestrian signage will be installed, and pedestrians will be encouraged to use Geddes Street as an alternate route. He commented on the completion of County work on Geddes Street and plans to maintain resident access and parking throughout the construction period.

A. McNabb responded to questions from Council regarding proposed parkette funding, he commented the view would be to include parkette as a level of service enhancement and the Township would be seeking alternate sources of funding or community partners to support that project.

items.title: Reserve and Reserve Fund Policy Update
notes: Report from Adam McNabb, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer Adam McNabb, Chief Financial Officer & Treasurer provided an overview of the report stating that municipal reserves and reserve funds are important long term municipal financial planning tools used to set aside funds to meet future funding requirements and further commented that having a reserve and reserve funds policy in place provides guidance for Township staff in preparing the annual operating and capital budgets and noted that this report identifies proposed changes to the Reserve and Reserve Fund Policy.

A. McNabb responded to comments and questions from Council regarding the recommended new reserves, the establishment of the MAT tax reserve fund, benefit to tourism initiatives and inclusion of economic development initiatives and connection to the MSE Board budget still supported through Township Council, and further commented on recommended funding targets for WSIB ABO Reserve fund and McDonald Trust reserve, those funds were directed back to the township and are formulated as part of the Bissel park project.

D. Wilson, CAO commented that there will be opportunity to discuss the reserve fund in more detail, will be bringing forward a more detailed policy like the OLG policy, as part of the 2027 Budget deliberations.
